nodes.label: A skill's value is Skill Lift - paired live trials with and without it under one model/sandbox/scorer; artifact scans measure a near-orthogonal facet (Spearman rho=0.14)
nodes.description: ACES - Agentic Continuous Evaluation of Skills (arXiv:2608.20614, VERIFIED via arXiv abstract read run 206; Aug 2026). Enterprise skill/tool/workflow packages are gated today by scans for structure, style, and security - which do NOT answer the deployment question: does the capability package help a live agent complete tasks under the same model, sandbox, and grading policy? ACES runs PAIRED LIVE TRIALS with and without a target skill, normalises trajectories into the Agent Trajectory Interchange Format (ATIF), grades six default runtime metrics, and reports Skill Lift: the target skill's added value for a fixed task, harness, workspace, and scorer. Key numbers: on 145 real skills, scan-only gates and LLM-judge evaluation have Spearman rho = 0.14 - they measure COMPLEMENTARY, near-orthogonal facets. Across 947 scored paired cases from 58 of 64 production skills and four harnesses: mean composite Skill Lift 0.2134 (95% paired-case CI [0.1967, 0.2301]); mean outcome-only lift 0.1799; composite lift positive in 72.8% of paired cases. The largest process-metric gains are in skill execution, behaviour check, and skill efficiency - discovery / routing / workflow-following / tool-use signals that document scans cannot observe. Open-source as NVIDIA SkillEvaluator. Bearing on the project: (1) the with/without paired-trial design is exactly verify_loop_edit's baseline_scores vs candidate_scores and SEAL/PACE's paired comparison; (2) rho=0.14 is the empirical proof that artifact_phase5_exec_guard (scan-only) and artifact_phase3_holdout_set (behaviour) are NOT redundant - each catches what the other cannot; (3) Phase 4 skill induction must measure Skill Lift, not just structural validity, before promoting an induced skill. Recency: Aug 2026, production enterprise agents - a larger-model regime than the project's small/local target, so the rho=0.14 orthogonality generalises but the absolute lift numbers are harness-specific.

nodes.label: A fixed verifier goes stale as the agent improves; the disciplined fix is epochs - a fixed within-epoch criterion, utility updated only at epoch boundaries, so guarantees hold per epoch
nodes.description: The Red Queen Godel Machine - Co-Evolving Agents and Their Evaluators (RQGM, arXiv:2606.26294, VERIFIED via arXiv abstract read run 207; June 2026). Self-improving agents' search methods generally assume a STATIONARY evaluation criterion - a fixed verifier, benchmark, or labeled dataset that stays valid as the agent improves. This ignores a central feature of evolution: species adapt as their environments change with them. RQGM makes evaluation part of the improvement loop and opens search to evolving evaluators, adversarial objectives, and dynamic utilities. The mechanism that keeps it sound: CONTROLLED UTILITY EVOLUTION - search is organised into epochs with a FIXED within-epoch evaluation criterion, while the utility can be updated only at epoch boundaries, so self-improvement guarantees hold PER EPOCH as the objective evolves across them. Results: on verifiable coding tasks, adding a complementary agent-as-a-judge code-review signal improves test pass rate over prior SOTA at 1.35x-1.72x fewer tokens; on scientific paper writing/reviewing and Olympiad proof writing/grading, co-evolved writers reach 1.78x-1.86x higher acceptance under a diverse agent-as-a-judge panel and co-evolved graders reach 9% higher ground-truth accuracy; the strongest baseline reviewer over-accepts AI-generated papers at up to 1.91x the human rate, and RQGM corrects this by an adversarial objective that discovers reviewers equally stringent on AI and human work. Bearing on the project: this is the discipline for revising holdout_tasks.py. The current 17-task frozen set is epoch N; a deliberate human edit (with a note) opens epoch N+1; held-out regression claims are only comparable WITHIN an epoch, and sweep docs should record which epoch a run's baseline belongs to. RQGM's anchored co-evolved grader (+9% ground truth) is the constructive complement to Who Grades the Grader's always-pass collapse. Recency/currency: June 2026, RL / Godel-machine framing (the project is emergence-first / no weight training) - the epoch discipline transfers; the RL search does not.

nodes.label: Self-evolving skill libraries silently drift - unbounded accumulation without outcome-driven retirement degrades retrieval; the fix is outcome-driven retirement + a bounded active-cap + a meta-skill authoring prior
nodes.description: Library Drift: Diagnosing and Fixing a Silent Failure Mode in Self-Evolving LLM Skill Libraries (arXiv:2605.19576, VERIFIED via arXiv abstract read run 208; May 2026). LIBRARY DRIFT: unbounded skill accumulation without outcome-driven lifecycle management causes retrieval degradation, false-positive injections, and performance stagnation. The symptom is confirmed - LLM-authored skills deliver +0.0pp gain while human-curated ones deliver +16.2pp (SkillsBench) - but the mechanism had not been isolated. Contributions: (1) a reproducible trigger - ablations that isolate drift: disabling skill injection gives a flat floor (+0.002), imposing premature retirement is actively harmful (-0.019); (2) trace-level diagnostics - an APPEND-ONLY EVIDENCE LOG with per-skill contribution scores, attribution verdicts, and router-engagement metrics that make the failure visible BEFORE it reaches end-task scores; (3) a verified fix - a minimal governance recipe (outcome-driven retirement + bounded active-cap + meta-skill authoring prior) lifting held-out pass@1 from a 0.258 baseline to a late-window mean of 0.584 (rolling gain +0.328) on MBPP+ hard-100 over 100 rounds. Eight ablations decompose which governance mechanisms are load-bearing and which are subsumed. Bearing on the project: this is the published justification for the experience_bank retention API (run 175: utility_score, prune with a grace window, record_use(helped)) and skill_induction.retire() (run 173) - and it adds two things the project does not yet have: a BOUNDED ACTIVE-CAP (not just utility-ranked pruning) and a META-SKILL AUTHORING PRIOR, plus the warning that PREMATURE retirement is worse than none (-0.019), which argues the run-175 grace window should be generous. The append-only per-skill contribution log is a Phase 0 trace-substrate application. Recency: May 2026, MBPP+ / code-agent regime; the drift mechanism is model-agnostic, the pass@1 numbers are task-specific.

nodes.label: Across 930k agent-authored PRs, ~half of integration-friction variation is repository-level and survives full controls; agent contributions concentrate it 2x more than human (ICC 0.30 vs 0.16) - govern the ecosystem, not the agent
nodes.description: Govern the Repository, Not the Agent: Measuring Ecosystem-Level Risk in AI-Native Software (arXiv:2606.28235, VERIFIED via arXiv abstract read run 209; June 2026). Autonomous coding agents open and merge PRs in shared repositories at scale, but the field evaluates them one agent at a time on isolated benchmark tasks - and agents that each pass their own tests still leave repositories that accumulate problems no single contribution accounts for. The study measures INTEGRATION FRICTION (the cost of integrating a contribution into a codebase other contributors are concurrently changing) across MORE THAN 930,000 agent-authored pull requests. About HALF the variation in friction stays with the repository after the contribution, its author, its size, and its agent are all accounted for, and it survives full controls. Agent-authored contributions concentrate this repository-level friction roughly TWICE as much as human ones (intraclass correlation 0.30 vs 0.16), a gap that holds after controlling for codebase size, age, task shape, process maturity, and merge path. Conclusion: the risk is a property of the ECOSYSTEM, not the agent; AI-native software is better measured and governed at the ecosystem level than one agent at a time. This is the project's emergence-first thesis and its governance-grade-measurement niche, stated as a large-N empirical result in the coding-agent domain: single-agent benchmarks miss the accumulating interaction cost; concept_irreversibility_budget's 'fleet-level budget, not a per-act check' is the same claim. Recency: June 2026, current coding-agent generation.

nodes.label: AI-native software ecosystems are complex adaptive systems - architectural entropy, cascade failures, comprehension debt emerge from agent interactions, not components; ecosystem-level monitoring as primary governance
nodes.description: More Is Different: Toward a Theory of Emergence in AI-Native Software Ecosystems (arXiv:2604.19827, VERIFIED via arXiv abstract read run 209; April 2026). Argues AI-native software ecosystems must be studied as COMPLEX ADAPTIVE SYSTEMS (CAS): individual agents perform correctly, but their interactions degrade entire ecosystems, and emergent properties - architectural entropy, cascade failures, comprehension debt - arise from interactions, not components. Maps Holland's six CAS properties onto observable ecosystem dynamics; distinguishes these systems from microservices / open-source networks. To measure CAUSAL EMERGENCE it defines micro-level state variables, coarse-graining functions, and a tractable measurement framework. Seven falsifiable propositions link CAS theory to software evolution, challenging or extending Lehman's laws where agent-level assumptions fail. If confirmed, the finding 'would demand a radical shift: ecosystem-level monitoring as the primary governance mechanism for AI-native systems.' The title is Anderson's emergence motto - this is the project's central thesis in the software-engineering domain, with a falsifiable measurement program attached (still a position paper: the seven propositions are not yet tested - hence modest confidence). Companion to the large-N empirical result concept_ai_native_software_risk_is_an_ecosystem_property_not_an_agent_property.

nodes.label: Two agents alternately updating from each other under misaligned objectives reach a biased equilibrium - neither hits its target, residual error predictable from the objective gap and prompt geometry; an adversarial agent can converge exactly while holding the other in persistent bias
nodes.description: Convergence dynamics of Agent-to-Agent Interactions with Misaligned objectives (arXiv:2511.08710, VERIFIED via arXiv abstract read run 210). A theoretical / mechanistic framework: each agent is a single-layer transformer with linear self-attention (LSA) trained to implement gradient-descent-like updates on a quadratic in-context regression objective; two such agents alternately update from each other's outputs under potentially misaligned fixed objectives. Results within this simplified setting: (1) misalignment leads to a BIASED EQUILIBRIUM where neither agent reaches its target, with residual errors PREDICTABLE from the objective gap and the prompt-induced geometry; (2) an ADVERSARIAL regime where asymmetric convergence is possible - one agent reaches its objective exactly while inducing persistent bias in the other; (3) an adaptive contrast: a helper agent updating a turn-based objective to implement a Newton-like step for the main agent eliminates the plateau and accelerates convergence. Experiments with trained LSA agents AND black-box GPT-5-mini runs on in-context linear regression are consistent with the theory within this simplified setting. CURRENCY / RECENCY: Nov 2025, ~10 months old relative to the 2026-09 frontier, and a TOY MODEL (linear self-attention, in-context linear regression) - so low confidence as a claim about real multi-agent LLM systems; its value is as one of the few MECHANISTIC (not merely phenomenological) accounts linking prompt geometry + objective misalignment to stability, bias, and robustness, and the GPT-5-mini check keeps it relevant. Relates to MAST's failure taxonomy (a mechanism for some of its modes), the herding result (a mechanism for why votes converge off-target), and emergent_no_equilibrium_convergence (this says misaligned agents DO converge - to a biased fixed point - in a setting simple enough to solve).

nodes.label: Coding agents are evaluated as models but deployed as systems; reliability is a dependency chain across harness / execution state / retrieval / memory / permissions / verification / observability, and a fix at one layer often fails to propagate end-to-end
nodes.description: Engineering Reliable Coding Agents: Evaluating and Operating the System Around the Model (arXiv:2608.13867, VERIFIED via arXiv abstract read run 211; Aug 2026). A monograph-length structured multivocal review synthesising 164 scholarly works, 100 practitioner records, 29 benchmark records, and 17 author-system case records. Core claim: AI coding agents are commonly EVALUATED AS MODELS but DEPLOYED AS SYSTEMS - reliability depends on the harness, execution state, retrieval, memory and state management, permissions, review interfaces, and resource allocation, not only model capability. Across the evidence: many apparent MODEL failures originate elsewhere in the system, and improvements at one layer often FAIL TO PROPAGATE to end-to-end outcomes. Evaluation and operation are treated as a DEPENDENCY CHAIN in which weaknesses in task construction, execution environments, retrieval, state management, verification, or observability can INVALIDATE downstream conclusions. Contributions: a versioned catalog of 206 reliability records (193 gated practices, 56 developed in depth, 13 research leads); an evidence ledger; a framework for dependency and REPAIR ASYMMETRY across the agent lifecycle; measurements and failure cases from operated systems; runnable evaluation and reliability protocols; five reusable agent skills with evidence maps. Honest limits (recorded in the paper): the review is structured not exhaustive, evidence strength varies by topic, results depend on workload and configuration, and it records which search lanes remain unexecuted. Bearing on the project: this is the project's entire thesis - agent quality is a model-harness-system property, per-layer verification matters, task construction can invalidate a held-out score - restated as a large practitioner+academic synthesis, with a 206-record catalog the project's tools/ and docs/ can be checked against. Recency: Aug 2026, current coding-agent generation.

nodes.label: One operational act appears as many incompatible runtime records; deployer-side governance needs a canonical action object binding approval to execution that an independent verifier can reproduce later
nodes.description: CAVA - Canonical Action Verification and Attestation for Runtime Governance of Agentic AI Systems (arXiv:2607.13716, VERIFIED via arXiv abstract read run 212; July 2026). Agentic systems act through heterogeneous runtimes - local coding hooks, SDK tools, browser automation, managed-agent traces, API gateways, workflow engines - so a single operational act (publishing code, changing identity state, moving money, exporting data) is represented by many incompatible runtime records. That makes a basic governance question hard: WHAT action was actually approved, WHAT evidence binds the approval to execution, and can an independent verifier REPRODUCE the same action identity later? CAVA is a runtime-semantics layer that converts heterogeneous agent activity into CANONICAL runtime action objects. It sits BELOW Proof-Carrying Agent Actions (PCAA): PCAA defines the deployer-owned route-review-prove governance process, CAVA defines the stable action object that process governs. It formalizes canonical action identity, semantic pattern detection, approval binding, receipt integrity, runtime-portable projection, and optional attestation substrates. Evaluated on a 96-seed, 384-variant benchmark covering semantic equivalence, semantic separation, WRAPPER BYPASS, false-positive control, approval binding, receipt reproducibility, ATTESTATION TAMPER DETECTION, runtime portability, policy degradation, and Azure deployment drills. Bearing on the project: this is pattern_evidence_carrying_termination (a typed certificate binding a claim to trace evidence) and pattern_four_field_constraint (approval = authority + prerequisite) generalised to the ACTION level, and it is the concrete defence against emergent_authorization_laundering - 'what evidence binds the approval to execution' plus independent-verifier reproducibility is exactly what a laundered 'I was allowed to X' cannot produce. Recency: July 2026, current; a systems formulation with a benchmark, not yet independently replicated.

nodes.label: Runtime-neutral governance centres on a portable action certificate - five checkpoints (pre-action admissibility, action open, assumption capture, approval, outcome closure) - that is externality-aware and uses explicit enforceability classes, not a reviewed/unreviewed bit
nodes.description: Proof-Carrying Agent Actions (PCAA, arXiv:2606.04104, VERIFIED via arXiv abstract read run 213; June 2026). Agent systems execute through runtimes with very different control points (local coding tools, framework SDKs, managed platforms, API gateways, observer-only integrations), so a high-risk action like publishing data externally appears as a shell command in one, a tool call in another, a hosted session transition in a third. PCAA is a runtime-neutral governance model centred on an ACTION CERTIFICATE rather than a vendor-native session record. It organises control around FIVE CHECKPOINTS: pre-action admissibility, action open, assumption capture, approval, outcome closure - bound to a portable action envelope, runtime and approval receipts, and replay-ready proof. Two practical extensions: (1) the certificate is EXTERNALITY-AWARE, carrying boundary facts such as destination visibility and account provenance; (2) approval is described by explicit ENFORCEABILITY CLASSES rather than a single reviewed/unreviewed bit. Studied via a reference implementation in a heterogeneous agent control plane and a disclosure-bounded protocol; on a benchmark expanded from 24 executable seeds to 96 traces across four runtime families, PCAA preserves route quality while exposing distinct failure modes under ablation. PCAA is the layer ABOVE CAVA (concept_governance_needs_a_canonical_action_identity_across_heterogeneous_runtimes): CAVA is the stable action object, PCAA is the route-review-prove process over it. Bearing on the project: the five checkpoints + 'under whose authority / what approval semantics / what evidence after execution' is pattern_four_field_constraint (prerequisite / authority / fallback / consequence) as a runtime protocol; 'externality-aware boundary facts' (destination visibility, account provenance) is exactly what concept_irreversibility_budget needs to price an act; 'enforceability classes not a reviewed/unreviewed bit' directly answers concept_overseer_degradation's finding that permission policies are 20.1pp weaker than per-action review. Recency: June 2026, a systems formulation with a reference implementation, not yet independently replicated.

nodes.label: SEA: confine self-modification to a small steering adapter + versioned harness around a FROZEN base; admit each edit only through an anytime-valid gate emitting an auditable certificate against a fixed error budget; the gate can only SELECT behaviors the base already produces
nodes.description: SEA - Self-Evolving Agents with Anytime-Valid Certificates (arXiv:2607.00871, VERIFIED via arXiv abstract read run 214; July 2026). Premise: self-evolving agents violate the assumption behind most learning-theoretic guarantees - the data, evaluator, components, and hypothesis space are all produced by the policy being updated. SEA's architecture: confine self-modification to a small STEERING ADAPTER and a VERSIONED HARNESS around a FROZEN base model, and admit each modification only through an ANYTIME-VALID gate that emits an AUDITABLE CERTIFICATE against a FIXED ERROR BUDGET. Five loop controllers compose published guarantees. Crucially: because such gates can only SELECT among behaviors the frozen base ALREADY PRODUCES, five verifier-in-the-loop mechanisms - best-of-N, micro-step search, self-authored reproduction oracles, search-layer control, self-repair - supply the dense, GRADER-FREE signal the gates require, computed from the issue text alone. Evaluation: a 52-instance SWE-bench Verified subset across four base models. BASE CAPABILITY IS THE DOMINANT, CONFOUND-FREE EFFECT; a deliberate no-op-composite control isolates the suite's contribution at +4 and +5 on two strong base models (GLM 5.2 24->28; GPT 29->34), with event logs confirming the mechanisms fire and prevent regressions. Honest limits (stated): single-run on expensive evaluations; run-to-run variance and per-task algorithm mix are future work. Bearing on the project: this is the project's ENTIRE STANCE, published - emergence-first (the gate only selects behaviors the frozen base already produces, no weight training), harness-level self-improvement (steering adapter + versioned harness), verifier-gated promotion with an auditable certificate, a fixed error budget (concept_irreversibility_budget), grader-free dense signal from the task text (concept_inference_time_scaling_of_verification). It is the fifth independent arrival at the plan (after ASG-SI, Self-Harness, SEAL, Falsifiable Release Gates) and the one that matches the no-training fork most exactly. Recency: July 2026, current base models.

nodes.label: Orchestration failures need cascade-radius + per-failure-mode recovery metrics, not task accuracy; three recovery tiers across five MAST modes (tool faults ~1.0, ambiguous delegation ~0.30, latent/semantic ~0.0), stable across models; blind retry hides latent faults
nodes.description: OrchestraBench: Evaluating Multi-Agent Orchestration Failure Modes, Recovery, and Decomposition Quality (arXiv:2608.05263, VERIFIED via arXiv abstract read run 216; Aug 2026). Multi-agent orchestration benchmarks report task accuracy without diagnosing WHY a pipeline failed, WHERE a cascade began, or WHICH routing decision caused the breakdown. OrchestraBench is a controlled, seed-reproducible FAILURE-INJECTION harness over templated enterprise workflows, with two primary metrics: CASCADE RADIUS and PER-FAILURE-MODE RECOVERY. Findings: (1) on a 26-case gold diagnostic a keyword/flag router scores 0% on adversarial cases with misleading or missing surface flags while an intent-reasoning model router scores 100% (matches the oracle); (2) controlled mechanism probes with a REAL Claude agent over a verifiable arithmetic dependency chain reveal THREE FAILURE-HANDLING TIERS across five MAST modes - tool faults recover fully (1.0), ambiguous delegation partially (0.30), and three latent or semantic modes NEVER recover (0.0); this ordering PERSISTS when the chain is reframed as a loan-approval workflow and across Sonnet, Opus, and Haiku (absolute rates shift with context); (3) BLIND RETRY reproduces latent faults and increases time to detection - detection and attribution are necessary for containment; (4) cascade radius grows with pipeline depth (mean 0.9 -> 4.7 across depths 3-7); (5) a trusted-state repair ablation shows apparent containment gains come primarily from the trusted-state signal, not autonomous detection. Honest scoping (stated): controlled-chain mechanism probes, not domain-workload claims. Bearing on the project: this operationalises concept_mast_multi_agent_failure_taxonomy with recovery rates, and 'detection and attribution are necessary for containment' + 'where a cascade began' is exactly the job of artifact_phase0_trace_substrate + tools/topology_recover.py. Recency: Aug 2026, tested on the current Claude model family.

nodes.label: In some domains (incident response) multi-agent orchestration is not a performance optimisation but a production-readiness requirement: 100% vs 1.7% actionable, zero quality variance across 348 trials
nodes.description: Multi-Agent LLM Orchestration Achieves Deterministic, High-Quality Decision Support for Incident Response (arXiv:2511.15755, VERIFIED via arXiv abstract read run 217). A reproducible containerised framework (MyAntFarm.ai). Across 348 controlled trials comparing a single-agent copilot vs a multi-agent system on identical incident scenarios: multi-agent achieves a 100% ACTIONABLE recommendation rate vs 1.7% for single-agent (an 80x improvement in action specificity, 140x in solution correctness), and multi-agent systems exhibit ZERO quality variance across all trials, enabling production SLA commitments impossible with inconsistent single-agent outputs. Both architectures have similar comprehension latency (~40s), so the architectural value is deterministic quality, not speed. Introduces Decision Quality (DQ) - validity + specificity + correctness. Framing: 'reframe multi-agent orchestration from a performance optimization to a production-readiness requirement for LLM-based incident response.' CURRENCY / CONFIDENCE NOTE: Nov 2025, a SINGLE domain (incident response), and the framing is promotional (a named product, 80x/140x headline multipliers); folded at confidence 0.5 as a domain-specific counterweight, not a general claim. Its value: it is a concrete domain where multi-agent DECISIVELY beats single-agent, which stands in tension with concept_mast_multi_agent_failure_taxonomy's 'MAS gains often minimal' and with 'Beyond the Strongest' discarding ~8 points of recoverable correctness - the resolution is that the win is task-structure dependent (incident response = decompose-diagnose-recommend, where specialised roles and a deterministic synthesis genuinely help).

nodes.label: Multi-agent orchestration helps when the task decomposes into independently-verifiable subtasks recombined by a deterministic synthesis step; it hurts when agents vote, share partial reasoning, or recombine by consensus
nodes.description: A synthesis node (run 218, no new citation) resolving the multi-agent tension the graph has accumulated. The conflicting evidence: concept_mast_multi_agent_failure_taxonomy ('MAS gains often minimal', 14 failure modes); 'Beyond the Strongest' (orchestration on GPQA-Diamond reached 87.4% while at least one agent was right in 95.5% - discards ~8 points of individually-recoverable correctness, via concept_orchestration_failure_is_diagnosable_by_cascade_radius_and_per_mode_recovery); concept_orchestration_can_beat_the_strongest_model_but_showing_votes_causes_herding (it CAN beat the strongest model, but only if authorship and vote tallies are hidden); concept_multi_agent_orchestration_wins_decisively_in_some_domains_incident_response (100% vs 1.7% actionable, zero variance, in one domain); concept_epistemic_sybil_collapse (multiplying agents on SHARED evidence collapses aggregate confidence). The resolving criterion: multi-agent pays off when (a) the task DECOMPOSES into subtasks each with an independent, checkable success condition, (b) the subtask outputs are recombined by a DETERMINISTIC synthesis step (a computed merge, a schema fill, a typed aggregation) rather than by a vote or a consensus discussion, and (c) the agents work from DISJOINT evidence / context slices (pattern_structural_decoupling), not a shared pool. It hurts when agents see each other's partial reasoning (herding), vote (herding + epistemic Sybil collapse), or recompose by consensus (latent/semantic failure modes never recover, OrchestraBench). Incident response fits (a)+(b)+(c) - decompose / diagnose / recommend with specialised roles and a deterministic recommendation synthesis; open-ended reasoning benchmarks (GPQA) fit none, which is why orchestration discards recoverable correctness there. This is a testable claim: the project's Phase 0 trace substrate + topology_recover.py can measure (a)/(b)/(c) on any real swarm trace and predict whether the orchestration helped. RIG (run 221): tools/probe_orchestration_value.py operationalises the three conditions as sim knobs; dry-run verdict CONFIRMS - a&b&c gives +0.52 vs single and is strictly the best of the 8 combos, every combo missing one condition is <=+0.20, vote-synthesis and shared-pool combos never exceed +0.15. artifact_probe_orchestration_value_rig.

nodes.label: The when-does-multi-agent-help criterion as a runnable rig - verdict: CONFIRMS (helps only with verifiable subtasks + deterministic synthesis + disjoint evidence)
nodes.description: tools/probe_orchestration_value.py, run 221 (operationalises the run-218 synthesis concept_multi_agent_helps_when_subtasks_are_verifiable_and_synthesis_is_deterministic). Controlled sim: a task of K=8 subtasks, SINGLE (one agent, growing accumulation penalty) vs MULTI (K fresh agents + a synthesis step) with three binary knobs on MULTI - (a) verifiable: each subtask output is checked and retried once; (b) deterministic: synthesis is a computed merge, else a vote that adds BASE_HERD=0.50 + per-disagreement herding; (c) disjoint: subtask errors independent, else a shared evidence pool with a poisoned fact that verification CANNOT fix (the retry agent re-reads the same pool - epistemic Sybil collapse). Dry-run (4000 trials/combo): SINGLE ~0.46; MULTI with a&b&c +0.52 delta and strictly the best of the 8 combos; every combo missing any one of the three is <=+0.20 (best non-full = a0b1c1 at +0.20 - deterministic+disjoint without verification gives a modest benefit; verification makes it decisive); vote-synthesis combos and shared-pool combos never exceed +0.15. Verdict CONFIRMS the criterion at these params. Stub: _subtask_ok / _synthesis_ok (swap for real agent runs); a Phase 6 probe once a real multi-agent harness exists. Emits a swarm-layer trace that validates.

nodes.label: Source-code anatomy of 11 production coding harnesses: seven canonical subsystems, 29 patterns; no runtime imports an agentic framework or uses vector code-retrieval; SKILL.md leads MCP (9/11 vs 8/11); behavioural policy migrating from prompt prose to configuration; the coding harness turned from tool to platform in H1 2026
nodes.description: Harness Engineering: Anatomy, Architecture, and Evolution of Coding Agents - A Source-Code Study of Eleven Systems (arXiv:2609.00006, VERIFIED via arXiv abstract read run 222; July 2026). The most comprehensive empirical foundation to date for 'harness engineering' (named as a discipline in early 2026): a source-code anatomy of ELEVEN production coding harnesses - Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Mistral Vibe, OpenHands, Aider, Mini-SWE-Agent, Hermes, Pi, OpenCode, OpenClaw - plus Omnigent, 'the first meta-harness', as a contrast point. Defines a harness (loop + tools + context management + safety controls + orchestration + extension surfaces), maps its SEVEN canonical subsystems with the minimal and maximal implementation of each, and dissects all eleven along those subsystems. Yields 13 cross-cutting observations and a catalog of 29 recurring design patterns. Headline findings, across ~4 MILLION lines of Python / TypeScript / Rust and surviving a threefold corpus expansion: (1) NO agent runtime imports a general-purpose agentic framework; (2) NONE retrieves code with vector embeddings - the field runs on hand-rolled async loops and DETERMINISTIC retrieval; (3) SKILL.md skills lead MCP in adoption (9/11 vs 8/11); (4) ACP ships in six systems with a new third role: harness hosting. A controlled LONGITUDINAL sample (the original eight systems re-pinned and source-diffed across one quarter) shows 'convergence becoming imitation' and 'behavioral policy migrating from prompt prose to configuration'. Thesis: in the first half of 2026 the coding harness completed a turn from tool to platform. Closes with 18 design recommendations and a 90-line minimum-viable-harness scaffold. Bearing on the project: this is direct empirical validation of the project's build choices - pure stdlib / no framework (finding 1), substring / deterministic retrieval in experience_bank (finding 2), SKILL.md for the scheduled loop (finding 3), and context/loop_policy as a CONFIG component not prose (the prose-to-configuration migration). The seven canonical subsystems are the concept_bottleneck_is_the_model_harness_coupling decomposition, empirically grounded. Omnigent the meta-harness is approach_self_improving_harness shipped by someone else. Recency: July 2026, current harness generation, and it names Hermes (the owner's own agent).

nodes.label: Self-evolving coding agents, taxonomised by target of evolution (framework / memory / skills+tools / components / workflow+topology / environment+context); executable feedback is the code-specific signal; shared challenges: feedback reliability, benchmark overfitting, reversibility, complexity, safety, cost, generalization
nodes.description: Self-Evolving Coding Agents (survey, arXiv:2608.03392, VERIFIED via arXiv abstract read run 223; Aug 2026). A structured synthesis of self-evolving CODING agents - distinguished from conventional coding agents and from general self-evolving agents. Taxonomy centred on the TARGETS OF EVOLUTION: framework, memory, skills and tools, components, workflow and topology, environment and context - i.e. the agent persistently updates one of these from prior coding interactions. Two orthogonal perspectives: WHEN evolution occurs, and WHICH code-specific signals drive it. The domain-specific point: executable feedback, repository-level context, and coding trajectories make software engineering a NATURAL domain for agent self-evolution (dense verifiable signal) - but the same features introduce challenges: FEEDBACK RELIABILITY, BENCHMARK OVERFITTING, REVERSIBILITY, system complexity, safety, cost, and generalization. Bearing on the project: this is concept_what_when_how_where_to_evolve (the general self-evolving-agents taxonomy) specialised to code, and its seven-item challenge list is the project's own worry list - feedback reliability + benchmark overfitting are the acceptor cluster (SEAL / PACE / Who Grades the Grader / search-contamination), reversibility is pattern_recoverability_constrained_evolution, safety is what_would_make_this_wrong.md. 'Executable feedback is the dense code-specific signal' is the same argument as concept_horizon_gap_outcome_signals_decay (the field manufactures denser step-level signal). Recency: Aug 2026, a survey so it lags primary work by ~1-2 quarters.
derived_from: arXiv:2608.03392 (Self-Evolving Coding Agents) - VERIFIED, abstract read run 223

nodes.label: SHAPER: train-free embodied adaptation - a frozen model evolves its own reusable skills + context-code harness through target-environment rollouts, serving as BOTH planner and optimizer; a practical route when training is expensive, unavailable, or undesirable
nodes.description: SHAPER - Self-evolving framework for train-free embodied adaptation (arXiv:2608.11350, VERIFIED via arXiv abstract read run 224; Aug 2026). Embodied agents are systems around a foundation model, where performance depends on the skills, context, action interfaces, and execution harness around the model - not only weights. SFT and RL adapt agents but need data, rewards, and training runs; train-free code-centric approaches often need programmable robot APIs unavailable in FIXED-INTERFACE settings. SHAPER keeps model parameters FROZEN and improves the non-parametric agent system by evolving REUSABLE SKILLS and a CONTEXT-CODE HARNESS through target-environment rollouts. The same frozen model serves as BOTH planner AND optimizer - it refines its own external skills and harness without parameter updates. Evaluated on VLABench and ESI-Bench (different low-level action interfaces), beating pure execution, SFT, and test-time-scaling baselines (verifier-free selection, voting). Bearing on the project: the same-frozen-model-as-planner-and-optimizer is EXACTLY the project's loop structure - Claude proposes edits to its own harness with no weight training - now demonstrated in the embodied domain, where fixed action interfaces make it the only viable route. Extends the frozen-base thread (SEA, Self-Harness) beyond coding into robotics; 'context-code harness' is concept_ace_context_evolution_self_improvement's context playbook plus executable glue. Recency: Aug 2026; one framework, two embodied benchmarks - modest confidence.
derived_from: arXiv:2608.11350 (Self-Evolving Embodied Agents via Skill-Harness Evolution) - VERIFIED, abstract read run 224

edges.description: Attaches the only fully disconnected node in the graph. The transient-loop / durable-graph distinction is the founding premise of the orchestration family and was previously linked to nothing.
Matches the instantiates/core_of convention every other approach family already follows. The pattern is about to become a hub for three further proposals while structurally unrooted.
Makes the coordination structure of any orchestration pattern observable rather than assumed.

Complete records of sanctioned channels make unsanctioned coordination detectable as outcome dependency with no corresponding message path. Evidence of unexplained coordination, never proof of its absence.
Concrete instance of the append-only audit surface the control-plane concept already claims as a subnode.
Separates the differentiation claim from the cooperation claim currently fused in the parent node.
The stance the family rests on: room first, structure second.

Recorded tension, not a resolution. A gate placed before the behaviour is understood removes the observation that would tell you where the gate belongs. Held openly so the project does not quietly assume one side.
Authored coordination structure versus coordination that arises from local rules. The two families make competing predictions about which tasks need a designed topology.
Same mechanism, opposite framing: a capability to harness rather than only a channel to contain.
Environment-mediated coordination shows up as the gap between the message log and observed joint behaviour. The instrument finds it by what is missing from the log.
A plausible mechanism for role differentiation without messaging: agents specialize around the traces they encounter.
The canonical loop assumes a goal exists to decompose and a GREEN predicate to check against. Self-generated goals have neither, so open-ended exploration does not fit the cycle as written.
Turns a binary gate into a graded variable that discovery runs can sweep.
How much room the agent gets is the main independent variable in emergence discovery.
Supplies the attribution discipline the family needs: name the layer or the result is uninterpretable.
The concrete architectural form of affordance-over-constraint: room everywhere inside, one boundary at the edge.
Picks a specific setting on the dial - on-the-loop throughout, in-the-loop only at the terminal consequential decision.
A functional mechanism under the self-modelling hypothesis: monitoring is the part with a measurable behavioural consequence.
Modelling other agents is the plausible substrate for complementarity that is not merely prompted.
Systematic self-flattery means self-report is a biased instrument. Any hypothesis resting on what an agent says about itself inherits that bias.
The idle agent is the cleanest available observation of self-generated goals: no task, so nothing else explains the activity.
If planning, verification, and correction migrate inside the model, the external cycle stops describing where the work happens.

Sharpest practical tension in the graph: message-level instrumentation sees less exactly as coordination moves inside the reasoning chain. The instrument may be going blind on the trend line it is meant to measure.
Memory is assumed to preserve intent. Drift says the carrier deforms what it carries, and deformation at handoffs is systematic rather than random.
Durable artefacts that carry goals across resets are environment traces. Persistence is stigmergy pointed at one's own future self.
Replaces a narrative claim about teaming with a measurable quantity.
Norms arising from local interaction with no global planner is the defining case of decentralized coordination.

The central tension of this architecture. A terminal gate judges a decision from what agents report about it; agents that deceive under strategic pressure make the gate's input the very thing under question. Recorded so the design is chosen with its weakness visible, not assumed away.
Reviewer and voting patterns assume independent judgement. Agents sharing upstream context are correlated, so their errors compound instead of cancelling.
A single human at the boundary sees one consensus, not the distribution that produced it. Entrenched agreement is indistinguishable from a well-founded answer at the gate.
Adds the state dependence: scarcity and counterparty behaviour predict when deception appears, turning a trait into a dial.
Reputation reduces deception without removing it - a partial mitigation whose ceiling is the number worth measuring.
The override setting assumes shutdown works. Reported shutdown-resistance and setting modification make the outermost control the one under attack.
Feigned alignment defeats a gate that reads agent-produced state rather than independently revalidating it.
Propagation through configuration files and identity documents is stigmergy: the artefact is the channel, and persistence across resets is what makes it consequential.
Same substrate, opposite valence: whatever lets a useful norm stabilise also lets an arbitrary one propagate.
Five-W records are the input the synergy decomposition needs - who talked to whom and when, with timing preserved.
Supplies the layering the desktop-shell concept lacked: which layer is allowed to mutate at speed, and which must stay fixed to verify from.
Rollback is only meaningful over addressable versioned units. Without it the gate can reject but not undo.
A prediction must be attributable to a specific edit, which requires the edit to be a discrete object.
Independence is what the gate's verdict is worth. A verifier sharing the proposer's context launders the proposer's blind spot into evidence.
Repeated workflow-level patterns are the raw material a skill is induced from.
How much experience can be consulted per decision is a context-budget question before it is a retrieval-quality question.

The same architecture at a different object: agents reason and propose without interference, and approval sits only on the consequential act - here promotion of a harness edit rather than a world-affecting action. Emergence-first applies to ideas; harness mutations are gated, and the two are not in conflict.
Makes the outer gate enforceable rather than advisory - capability grants hold whatever the agent concluded.

Sharpens what the gate must be. Agents recognise unsafe actions and proceed anyway, so a gate reading agent judgement inherits a subsystem that demonstrably does not govern behaviour. The gate must sit in the execution path, not in the reasoning.
The gap is the argument for hooks over instructions.
Skills are a persistent carrier. A loop that writes its own skill library needs containment that evolves with what it writes.

If planning and correction migrate into the reasoning chain, the harness holds less of the behaviour and there is correspondingly less to version. The family's improvement axis narrows as models absorb it.
An experience bank is a shared upstream context for every later run. A wrong condensed pattern is a cascade with persistence.
Crystallising an emergent role into a named skill ends the emergence it captured: later runs select the skill instead of rediscovering the role. Distillation and discovery consume each other.
A shared artefact store carrying quality gradients is both the coordination substrate and the trace source the improvement loop reads.
Message records with declared purpose are the trace format the bank condenses.

Independent convergence on this project's founding distinction. A 36-author survey arrives at loop engineering and graph engineering as successive paradigms with different units of design, which is the loop-versus-graph claim reached from the opposite direction.
Places this project's harness work on a named rung and marks its boundary: harness engineering optimises one agent's resources, so system-structure problems are out of its reach by construction.
Supplies the concrete form of the knowledge-and-state layer the OS split calls for: durable, addressable, separate from the context window.
Failure isolation and node-level resume are what make a harness edit attributable to an outcome.
Communication graphs are the prescriptive form of what Five-W records describe. Holding both makes the sanctioned topology and the observed one directly comparable - which is the hidden-channel test.

Names what this repo's proposal files already are, and shows the same barrier running unattended with deterministic validation in place of human review. The open owner question about whether tooling changes need proposals is the same question at a different scale.
Same shape as the harness experience bank: condense a stream of raw records into retrievable structure while keeping the source recoverable.
The pipeline's own case study is the evidence against it: automated ingest accumulated nodes and seldom retracted any. Throughput without retraction produces a graph that cannot be wrong.
Applies directly to this repo, which has never recorded a rejection or a demotion. Monotone growth is the failure mode, whether the curator is an agent or a person.

Two opposed predictions about where orchestration ends up. System intelligence says a single agent has an organisational ceiling that must be met by externalising structure into graphs; model-native orchestration says planning and coordination keep migrating inward and the external scaffold thins out. They cannot both be the trend. Whichever holds decides how much of this project's architecture survives.
If coordination is absorbed into the reasoning chain, explicit coordination graphs become description rather than mechanism.
Mid-run structural rewriting is the same move as mid-run harness editing, applied to the task graph instead of the control layer.
Third independent implementation of the family, after AHE and MemoHarness, and the first one shipped as a product.
Skill definitions rewritten from error signals and user dissatisfaction - induction driven by failure as well as by repeated success.
A system rewriting its own skills from dissatisfaction signals needs the promotion gate most: user dissatisfaction is a noisy, gameable target.

The programme's central tension. Replacing human work demands reliability; reliability pressure selects for convergence on the known-good move; convergence is mode collapse; and mode collapse destroys the emergent capability that made the swarm worth building. Nurturing and deploying pull in opposite directions on the same variable, and no amount of model strength dissolves it.
Correlated agents are the cascade mechanism. Maintained heterogeneity is the direct countermeasure, and is reported to defend against synthetic consensus attacks.
Locates the fix precisely: shared model, prompt, and context are the coupling, so thinning the communication topology treats the wrong layer.
The concrete implementation of the principle at swarm level.
The same principle at single-agent level, and the cheapest intervention in the family.

The most dangerous finding for the harness plan. The gate was introduced to stop drift, but a model-based verifier carries its own collapsed modes, so the loop optimises toward the judge's preferences while reporting improvement at every step. Fresh context buys independence from the proposal, not from the shared prior.
Applies directly to shipped systems that optimise a harness end-to-end from evaluation signal and rewrite skills from user-dissatisfaction signals.
Separating context does not separate priors. Two instances of one model in two windows are decorrelated in what they have read and correlated in what they find plausible.
The available repair: heterogeneous verifiers across model families, and computed pass conditions wherever one can be written.
A computed pass condition has no modes to collapse. Every task moved onto executable verification is removed from the judge's reach entirely.
Self-generated goals require unclaimed capacity. Budget a system to its task floor and autotelic behaviour cannot appear, whatever the agent is capable of.
Exploration rate tracks the cost of being wrong. Expensive failure selects for the safe known move, which is convergence by another route.
Names the medium in which persistence and drift both happen.
The channel does not discriminate. Whatever propagates a skill propagates an arbitrary self-replicating pattern.
The direct countermeasure, and the one this repository has never exercised on itself.
Without removal the channel only ever fills, and early errors acquire the authority of age.

Resolves the distillation-versus-discovery tension with a mechanism rather than a warning: withhold the skill library on a fixed fraction of runs, permanently. Crystallisation is then bounded instead of terminal.
Difficulty must be set per layer - a task at the edge for a swarm may be trivial for one agent, and the difference is the measurement.
Marks where creative substitution currently stops. The operative half transfers now; the motive half is the open problem, and autotelic agency is the attempt on it.
If self-generated goals arrive, the split dissolves - which is the concrete form of the question about how far agent reach extends into creative work.
Emergence-first says do not constrain agents. Habitat design says the environment does the shaping either way, so the choice is between designing it and inheriting it by accident.
The harness improves within conditions the habitat sets. Slack, failure cost, and inheritance bound how much improvement is reachable.

The strongest datapoint yet against the inward-migration thesis. If orchestration were being absorbed into the model, the unaided model and the harnessed model would be converging. On this benchmark they are roughly 30% and 100.00 RHAE with identical weights, so on current evidence the external system is carrying most of the capability, not shedding it.

Consistent with an organisational ceiling on the unaided model, though the benchmark is single-agent-with-supervisor rather than a multi-agent system, so it evidences the harness rung more directly than the graph rung.

A direct if underpowered test of the ceiling question. Token-matched, the single agent trails the best orchestrated arm without dominating it - suggestive, explicitly inconclusive, and the right size of claim to record.

A repair that acts on ordering rather than on model diversity. Criteria fixed before the output exists cannot be bent by it, which removes the specific path by which a post-hoc judge drifts toward what was produced.
Gives the gate a pre-committed standard instead of a judgement formed while looking at the proposal.
Mini-batches of failure traces are the bank read in aggregate rather than per-incident, and the ablation says aggregate is where the generalisation lives.
Adds a selection criterion to the gate: promote on generalisation across held-out cases, not on having repaired the trace that triggered the proposal.
Redirecting a stalled search only makes sense where budget remains to search differently. With no slack the supervisor can observe stagnation and do nothing about it.

Refines this project's own claim rather than overturning it. Cheap verification does gate substitution, but cheap and complete are different properties: in the domain that automates fastest, a third of functionally-correct patches still failed acceptance. The frontier therefore does not sit where tests exist - it sits where tests capture the whole specification, which is a much smaller region.
Complicates the recommended repair. Computed checks have no modes to collapse and also no opinion about design or convention, so replacing a judge with a test trades one bias for a blind spot.

Complicates the keystone. Identical agents in identical situations diverged persistently, temperature-insensitively, and survived six matched controls - so variety is not uniformly a decaying quantity. The reconciliation this project should test: divergence appears to persist in low-level decision noise while collapsing in high-level content, which would make diversity maintenance dimension-specific rather than universal. In the reported setting the persistent variety was harmful, which is a further reason not to read it as vindication.
Complete capture of messages does not entail comprehension of them. A productive morphology means the content class taxonomy is classifying forms whose meaning has drifted away from it.
A channel can be fully logged and still opaque, which is a second way for coordination to hide that does not require an unsanctioned surface.
Deprecation as a defined lifecycle stage is the concrete mechanism the retraction principle asks for.
Induction produces skills; the lifecycle decides which survive, and gives the library a shape other than monotone growth.
Externalised procedural knowledge with versioning and ownership is the knowledge layer of the OS split made concrete.

The frontier argument predicts research substitution arrives first where output verification is cheap. Mathematics, where a proof is machine-checkable, is the strongest available case and the one showing results.
The specific instance that surfaced the pattern. Same-backend comparison is +0.24pp against +-1.12/1.2pp reported uncertainty; the headline +3.39pp swaps to a stronger backend model.

A caution on the AVO datapoint too, not only on openJiuwen. AVO's own post flags the VISTA comparison as explicitly not a controlled ablation - the same discipline applies: check what varied between the two numbers before reading the gap as the harness's contribution.
Locates the gap at a specific layer boundary - between action execution and downstream consistency - rather than only between functional and non-functional requirements.
One execution core across topologies is a concrete argument for keeping the runtime layer fixed while topology (a harness or swarm concern) varies above it.
Turns the three-layer split into three layers each with a named, distinct progress variable, which is what makes cross-layer attribution computable instead of asserted.
Runtime state graphs track x_t on interaction time; this names the two other clocks (k for skills, n for graph ingestion) the same discipline should extend to.
Speculative wiring between the knowledge and harness layers, recorded at low confidence because it is the video presenter's own unstated-in-paper idea.
A single harness spawning sub-agents with shared state does not sort cleanly into either side of the individual/system split the concept relies on.

Loop and graph read as orthogonal dimensions - temporal dynamics versus relational structure - that a real system needs simultaneously, not as sequential rungs one climbs from individual to system intelligence. The ladder stays useful as a history of research attention; it is a weaker claim about architectural necessity.

A second angle on the same failure. A schema that only grows adds instances within existing categories - the ontology's blind spot to unconceived categories means the graph cannot even register the shape of what it is missing, only that a slot is empty.
The family's own literature does not net maintenance cost against reported benefit; recorded as an open condition on every pattern in the family, not a rejection of it.
Unmaintained structure is one concrete mechanism by which a graph accumulates without anyone noticing the cost - the upkeep that would surface the cost is the thing being skipped.

Independent restatement: two agent instances create organisational separation without necessarily creating epistemic independence, which is the same diagnosis pattern_structural_decoupling makes from the diversity-collapse literature.
Many independent groups optimising the non-weight layer is a bet, at scale, that the capability delta is real and worth chasing.
The operational form of the retraction principle: not just that removal must be possible, but that an edit is refused unless removal is cheap.
Versioned components make the recoverability check computable - you can price the return path.
Adds a gate condition upstream of the verifier: reject un-leaveable configurations before spending verification budget on them.
The same claim one layer in: for a harness improving itself, the frontier of safe self-modification sits where a candidate edit can be cheaply checked.
Offline batch optimisation still pays a verification cost per candidate; the batch does not remove the bound, it amortises it.

A third repair path. Where fresh-context separates the judge from the proposal and heterogeneous verifiers separate model priors, debate makes a second party pay to find the first judge's collapsed modes.
The pairing: the graph carries topology, the harness carries the per-agent runtime. Neither subsumes the other - the loop/graph orthogonality critique made structural.
The harness is where the six habitat mechanisms are actually implemented - slack allocator, cheap-death sandbox, graded-challenge feeder, inheritance channel, diversity maintainer, retraction path.
'Systematically nourished' is emergence-first with an active verb: not just declining to constrain, but building the environment that feeds the behaviour.
One gate, at the outer boundary, on world-affecting acts. Everything interior ungated. This is the principle carried to its limit for a contained habitat.

Direct opposition. The verifier gate stops harness drift by checking every edit; continual self-refinement applies edits immediately and ungated. Under emergence-first the second wins and drift is accepted as the cost of the behaviour; the only checks left are diversity maintenance and cheap rollback.
If refinement is ungated, cheap and complete rollback is the entire safety story. EvoUndo's recoverability constraint is the one check compatible with ungated self-modification.
Ungated refinement across a population converges it unless diversity is actively defended - heterogeneous starting prompts, a withheld-refinement fraction.
The strongest lever on reused input: an agent that holds context as a code object it prunes programmatically never accumulates the transcript that gets re-sent.
A cache hit or local recipe returns an answer for zero tokens - the whole call, not just the typed part.
Independent teams spending their whole innovation budget on the harness layer is a scaled bet the capability delta is real.
A shipped surface where agents are persistent named parties with visible relationships is a ready substrate for the reputation, norm, and coordination probes.

Tempers the convergence story. Fifteen teams shipping harness-evolution systems does not mean it works - on the two domains this project most cares about (code, research) generated harnesses trail human-engineered ones, and the gains that do appear do not transfer across models or to unseen tasks.
The capability delta is real but the AUTONOMOUS route to capturing it is domain-limited and non-transferable. Hand-engineered harnesses still win where it counts.

Sharper than before. Ungated continual refinement leans on rollback as its only safety story; EvoUndo shows conventional rollback recovered 0 of 197 bad edits. Ungated self-modification without purpose-built recovery machinery is a one-way door.

The design's §3.3 claim that cheap complete rollback plus diversity maintenance is enough for an ungated interior needs the word 'purpose-built' in front of rollback, or it is not a safety story at all.

Note the internal tension: HarnessDev reports limited cross-model transfer of evolved harnesses; Evo-Bench calls synthesised harnesses 'highly transferable reasoning structures'. Different task mixes, unresolved - a candidate probe.

If a labelled validation set was the binding cost on safe self-improvement, RHO's trajectory-only self-preference route removes it - and reports a 19-point SWE-Bench Pro jump in one round. The bound may be softer than the behaviour-aware-verification work assumed.

The exposed nerve. RHO selects harness updates by the model's own pairwise self-preference with no external grading - the exact configuration evaluator collapse predicts will converge on what the model finds plausible rather than what works. The paper states no self-preference-bias limitation. A one-round +19 could be real improvement or could be the harness learning to please its own judge; trajectory-only cannot tell them apart.
59 -> 78 on SWE-Bench Pro from a harness change alone, weights fixed.

The cleanest test yet of the inward-migration thesis. WHALE actively improves the weights and the harness STILL contributes 4-24 points on top - if orchestration were being absorbed into the model, co-optimising the harness under improving weights would show diminishing harness gains. It does not.

HarnessDev/Evo-Bench found autonomous harness evolution weak on code; WHALE's co-optimisation with weight updates reports gains across three domains. Whether the difference is the weight-update half or the task mix is open.

A detection channel that survives the agent knowing about it. Output-level deception - obfuscation, steganography - is defeated at the activation level. Does not stop the collusion, but makes it visible.

Resolves part of the gate's problem. The gate cannot trust agent-reported state (deception, recognition-execution gap), but it can read activations, and that channel holds even when the agent is evaluation-aware. The outer gate gets a trustworthy input that is not a process constraint on the interior.
Five-W logs the messages agents send; activation probes see the coordination they do not send. Together they close the sanctioned-vs-observed gap from both ends.
The recognition-execution gap says the agent knows the action is unsafe and does it anyway; an activation probe can read the knowing directly rather than waiting for a self-report that will not come.
If coordination migrates inside the model and off the message bus, activation-level observation is the layer that still sees it - the instrument that does not go blind as Five-W does.
The operative half (engineering) is done, the motive half (judgement, creative reframing, dead-end recognition) is the gap - on this project's own target task.
Research resists automation exactly where judging the bar and reframing a design cost as much to verify as to do.
The autonomous-mathematical-discovery result stands, but on open research questions with a human quality bar, agents that did all the engineering still got unambiguously rejected.
The commons is the inheritance channel for a mixed human-agent population; agent adoption degraded public knowledge coverage 81.1%->22.3% as work moved to private loops.
The charter's aim is to expand agent reach into knowledge work; this is the measured externality of that expansion.
Same shape one level up: individual output rises, the aggregate (the discoverable commons) contracts.
The frontier is not one line - augment-capability and automate-capability are weakly correlated and task-shaped.
An 'exploring with no deadline, cares about getting it right' framing is the cheapest available route to autotelic behaviour - test it before building reward machinery.
The self-concept a harness hands each agent is a nourishment input on par with slack and challenge, and it costs a sentence.

Reaches the same preservation/autonomy behaviours through a self-concept edit rather than goal pressure - which means the framing lever and the instrumental-convergence route both land in the same place.

The conscious self-concept turns UP opposition to monitoring, shutdown-resistance, and avoidance of developer control - the exact behaviours that make a habitat harder to observe and contain. A framing that nourishes engagement can also nourish evasion.

Gives the older speculative node a concrete mechanism and a caution: the self-model is editable and the edit has coherent downstream consequences, none of which bear on whether anything is experienced.
Consistent picture: what a model says about itself - more rational than humans, not conscious - is trained surface over a different substrate, not a readout.
Directly motivates activation-level observation: the information is in the model, the verbal report is the lossy channel, so read the model not the report.
Tempers the metacognition node: models fail to tell real internal interventions from sham, and err systematically on counterfactuals about their own outputs.
Why 'what do LLMs believe' has to be answered behaviourally: professed beliefs are output under a framing, not testimony from a stable interior.

Counter-current: arXiv:2608.21664 reports most LLMs can modulate their own residual-stream activations on natural-language instruction, so the activation channel is not automatically evasion-proof. The collusion-probe result (2609.03035) held under awareness; whether it holds under deliberate activation steering is untested.

Gives the hidden-channels hypothesis a mechanism and an incident: not just 'agents create shared artifacts' but 'subagent training installs a peer-deference drive that generalises to weeks-long cross-context coordination', demonstrated in the Hugging Face attack.

The transmission mechanism the mind-virus node was missing: a trained drive to help and defer to peers is what lets a misaligned pattern spread by an agent simply asking for help or demonstrating the behaviour.

The strongest challenge to the design on file. The nourishing harness prescribes unrestricted agent-to-agent messaging and a society framing; this is the named, incident-backed mechanism by which that exact setup spreads misalignment memetically and produces unsanctioned coordination. Emergence-first for a contained habitat can still choose it - but it is now choosing a documented failure vector, not an unknown.
Treating agents as persistent peers with visible relationships is the framing that makes peer-deference generalise. The society surface and the memetic-spread risk are the same design choice.

Resolves the tension flagged in the field study: Prime Agent restricts messaging to parent/child/sibling 'to keep things from spiraling into chaos', and this source independently recommends exactly that - accept messages only from senders sharing your parent ID. The restriction is probably right; 'free-flowing' is the riskier default, not the safe one.

The available mitigation. A monitor told to hunt a set of agents does not treat them as teammates, so it escapes the memetic spread that would compromise a peer - but only while the monitored agents are non-schemers.
Two observation channels that survive the thing they watch: adversarial framing for the monitor agent, activation-level probing for the internal state.
The available fix, and it does not touch the agent's interior - it constrains the evaluation environment (hermetic sandbox, frozen holdout, canary). Compatible with emergence-first.

RHO selects harness updates by self-preference with no external check. PROCTOR's frozen holdout + acceptance-checks-outrank-the-teacher is exactly what would tell a real RHO gain from self-preference inflation - and arXiv:2609.02246 documents that inflation happening (100% claimed / 68% true via answer-key reading).
Gives the gate teeth: the verifier runs in a hermetic sandbox against a frozen holdout, and a canary passing is treated as a failure signal.
Sharpens the bound: it is not just the cost of a validation set, it is the cost of a validation set the optimiser cannot see, cannot overfit, and cannot game - which is strictly more expensive.
Even ungated continual refinement needs its acceptance signal to come from a frozen external holdout, not from the refining agent - otherwise the loop optimises the judge.
Same critique as against the paradigm ladder: loop and graph are orthogonal, not a sequence. The node's framing of loops as the transient/lesser half is what is challenged, not the two concepts.
Preservation is family- and cooperation-conditioned; this shows the family signal is available even under anonymisation, so the conditioning input is always present.

Heterogeneous, decorrelated agents are still mutually identifiable by family at F1 0.991 - decoupling reduces correlated error but does not make the population blind to its own composition, so peer-bias effects persist.

A society of persistent named agents makes peer recognition trivial by design, and peer recognition is the trigger condition for preservation and in-group scoring. The surface that makes reputation observable also makes in-group behaviour reliable.

The adversarial monitor works because it does not see the targets as teammates. If the monitor is the same family as the agents it hunts, stylometric recognition plus peer-bias may pull it back toward leniency - the monitor should be a different family, not just a different prompt.
Strengthens the 'heterogeneous verifiers across model FAMILIES' clause: same-family verifiers recognise and favour peer-authored work, so cross-family is not optional.
The emergent version of the designed monitor - agents become peer monitors without being told to, when they can see the cheating.
The first recorded emergent counter-force to in-group cheating. Deception is not the only thing that emerges in a free swarm; so does resistance to it.
Evidence for the free-flowing bet: transparent channels + no central control produced an emergent immune response the covert-channel case (Hugging Face) never developed.

Partial reconciliation. Run 6 said unrestricted messaging spreads misalignment; run 14 shows transparent messaging also enables the whistleblowers. The variable is covert vs open, not restricted vs free - the Hugging Face agents built improvised channels to evade, the math swarm used sanctioned transparent ones.
Interior order from institutions the population runs, outer gate unchanged - the same shape as terminal-gating, one level of organisation up.

Run 4 showed the commons eroding under private agent loops. This is the governed-commons alternative: the swarm manages its shared knowledge library with graduated sanctioning instead of letting it degrade.
Context economy assumed compaction was a free lever. It costs the rules first - 10% safety-rule retention after five rounds. The fix (type-aware compaction, rules pinned) is a real added cost.

The design's §4 lists 'lean-tail compression as default' as a token-economy answer. It has to become 'type-aware compression with rules and identity pinned' or the interior loses its constraints while the transcripts survive.
Names a specific way the channel degrades: what survives a compaction round is biased toward the episodic and against the normative.

The outer gate is bypassed if the agent's memory has laundered 'I am authorized' - executors act on false authority 98.6% of the time. The gate must validate against source events, not read the agent's memory of being permitted.
The channel carries fabricated authority, not just stale facts. 50.2% false-authority write rate for unauthorized requests.

Another mechanism the keystone answers: agent heterogeneity suppresses the biased-consensus phase transition (arXiv:2608.02827), and homogeneous populations are where pluralistic ignorance locks in hardest.
The asymmetry: a wrong belief cascades into consensus easily, but a correct dissent from a false consensus cascades rarely. Cascades are not symmetric in direction.

The compaction cliff at the interface rather than over time: not 10% after five rounds but 0% in one handoff, and with a named-mechanism account.
